test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Sunita always wears _________ clothes.
solution:
The correct answer is "**decent**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence suggests that Sunita wears clothes that are appropriate and respectable.
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "decent."**
 
 
• **Decent means appropriate, modest, and respectable.**(सभ्य)&l
